garment.songTitle: Touch the Hem of His Garment
garment.line: Said, "If I could just touch the hem of His garment
stanza: She cried "Oh, Lord (Oh, Lord), and whoa, Lord (Oh, Lord)
And oh, oh Lord, and whoa, Lord (Oh, Lord)"
Said, "If I could just touch the hem of His garment
I know I'll be made whole"
